1.text: Nimushimire Uwiteka yuko ari mwiza, 106.1; 118.1; 136.1; Yer 33.11Kuko imbabazi ze zihoraho iteka ryose.

2.text: Abacunguwe n'Uwiteka bavuge batyo,Abo yacunguye akabakura mu kuboko k'umwanzi,

3.text: Akabatarurukanya abakura mu bihugu,Aho izuba rirasira n'aho rirengera,Ikasikazi no ku nyanja.

4.text: Bazerereye mu butayu mu nzira itagira abantu,Ntibabona umudugudu wo kubamo.

5.text: Bicwa n'inzara n'inyota,Imitima yabo igwa isari.

6.text: Maze batakira Uwiteka bari mu byago,Abakiza imibabaro yabo.

7.text: Abashorerera mu nzira igororotse,Kugira ngo bagere mu mudugudu wo kubamo.

8.text: Abo bashimire Uwiteka kugira neza kwe,N'imirimo itangaza yakoreye abantu.

9.text: Kuko yahagije umutima wifuza,N'umutima ushonje yawujuje ibyiza.

10.text: Abandi bicaraga mu mwijima no mu gicucu cy'urupfu,Baboheshejwe umubabaro n'ibyuma,

11.text: Kuko bagomeye amagambo y'Imana,Bagasuzugura imigambi y'Isumbabyose.

12.text: Ni cyo cyatumye icishisha bugufi imitima yabo umuruho,Bakagwa ntibagire ubatabara.

13.text: Maze batakira Uwiteka bari mu makuba,Abakiza imibabaro yabo.

14.text: Abakura mu mwijima no mu gicucu cy'urupfu,Aca iminyururu yabo.

15.text: Abo bashimire Uwiteka kugira neza kwe,N'imirimo itangaza yakoreye abantu.

16.text: Kuko yamennye inzugi z'imiringa,Akavuna ibihindizo by'ibyuma.

17.text: Ibirimarima bibabarizwa ibicumuro byabyo,No gukiranirwa kwabyo.

18.text: Imitima yabo ihurwa ibyokurya iyo biva bikajya,Bakegera amarembo y'urupfu.

19.text: Maze bagatakira Uwiteka bari mu byago,Akabakiza imibabaro yabo.

20.text: Akohereza ijambo rye akabakiza indwara,Akabakiza kwinjira mu mva zabo.

21.text: Abo bashimire Uwiteka kugira neza kwe,N'imirimo itangaza yakoreye abantu.

22.text: Batamba ibitambo by'ishimwe,Bogeresha imirimo ye indirimbo z'ibyishimo.

23.text: Abamanuka bajya mu nyanja bakagenda mu nkuge,Bagatundira mu mazi y'isanzure,

24.text: Barebeye imirimo y'Uwiteka n'ibitangaza bye imuhengeri.

25.text: Kuko yategetse agahuhisha umuyaga w'ishuheri,Ushyira hejuru umuraba waho.

26.text: Barazamukaga bakajya mu ijuru,Bagasubira bakamanuka bakajya ikuzimu,Imitima yabo ikayagishwa n'umubabaro.

27.text: Bakazunga muzunga,Bakadandabirana nk'umusinzi,Ubwenge bwabo bwose bukazinduka.

28.text: Maze batakira Uwiteka bari mu byago,Abakiza imibabaro yabo.

30.text: Maze bīshimishwa n'uko utuje,Kandi abajyana mu mwaro bashakaga.

31.text: Abo bashimire Uwiteka kugira neza kwe,N'imirimo itangaza yakoreye abantu.

32.text: Bamwogereze mu iteraniro ry'abantu,Bamushimire aho abakuru bicaranye.

34.text: Igihugu cyera agihindura ubutaka bw'umunyu,Ku bw'ibyaha by'abahatuye.

35.text: Kandi ahindura ubutayu ikidendezi,No mu mburamazi ahahindura amasōko.

36.text: Aho ni ho aturiza abashonje,Kugira ngo batunganye umudugudu wo kubamo,

37.text: Babibe imirima batere imizabibu,Bibonere imbuto z'umwero.

38.text: Akabaha umugisha bakagwira cyane,Ntakundire inka zabo ko zigabanuka.

39.text: Kandi iyo bagabanutse,Bagacishwa bugufi n'agahato n'ibyago n'umubabaro,

40.text: Asuka igisuzuguriro ku bakomeye,Akabazerereza mu kidaturwa kitagira inzira,

41.text: Agashyira hejuru umukene amukuye mu makuba,Akamugwiriza imiryango nk'umukumbi.

42.text: Abakiranutsi barabireba bakishima,Ubugoryi bwose bukiziba akanwa.

43.text: Umunyabwenge wese azitegereza ibyo,Kandi bazita ku mbabazi z'Uwiteka.
